home.malayalamPhoneticNote: Phonetic translation: Segmenting Malayalam conjunct ligatures reduces phonological stress for bilingual dyslexic students learning in dual-medium classrooms.

home.pedagogyHeading: Built upon clinical cognitive research, not fleeting novelty.
home.pedagogyDesc: Every feature within ReadEase corresponds directly to published neuropsychological protocols for mitigating visual stress (Meares-Irlen syndrome), phonemic processing delays, and working memory overload.
home.cardSaccadicDesc: Rather than forcing the eye to decode uniform letterforms, ReadEase algorithmically weights phonetic anchor letters. This prevents saccadic regressions and lowers the ocular energy expenditure required to finish a single chapter.
home.cardBilingualDesc: South Asian syllabic orthographies (like Malayalam) pose distinct challenges for dyslexic children due to stacked ligatures and vowel diacritics. Our parser cleanly isolates conjunct consonants into digestible syllable blocks.
home.cardVisualStressDesc: High-contrast pure black-on-white causes optical glare and perceived 'letter vibration' for 46% of individuals with dyslexia. Our warm paper backdrops and ochre focal bands preserve visual comfort during multi-hour study sessions.
home.roleStudentDescNew: Ad-free reading environment, instant document upload, customized visual rulers, and synchronized text-to-speech with bilingual syllable tracking.
home.roleTeacherDescNew: Batch convert curriculum worksheets and reading assignments into accommodated formats. Track cohort engagement without stigmatizing students.
home.roleSpecialistDescNew: Document accommodation efficacy directly for IEP compliance. Export reading velocity, error regressions, and visual fatigue logs.
home.roleParentDescNew: Clear, compassionate growth markers without complex medical jargon. Support 15 minutes of evening reading with frictionless digital tools.
home.voicesHeading: Voices from classrooms, reading clinics, and homes.
home.testimonial1: For my 5th-grade dyslexic students, the combination of ochre visual shielding with saccadic fixations stopped the endless page headaches. They read for 25 continuous minutes without asking for a cognitive break.
home.testimonial2: I spent college having to re-read every single paragraph three times because my eyes drifted between sentences. Being able to set custom line spacing and font tracking in ReadEase has honestly changed how I study law.
home.testimonial3: The bilingual Malayalam support is unprecedented. Most assistive software only cares about standard English texts. Seeing stacked Malayalam letters rendered with phoneme spacing gave my daughter her confidence back.
home.ctaHeading: Every reader deserves a page that meets them halfway.
home.ctaSubtitle: Free for neurodivergent individuals, public school classrooms, and special education clinics. No tracking, no paywalls on basic accommodations.
